🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 7, 2026

Moon, in Libra, holds a conjunction to Venus, at home in the same sign. The same air temperament, twice over: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. Moon opposes you from Libra, and the account has two columns. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Sun in Scorpio sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio with no title of its own. From Libra, Moon concedes the point early. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. A week ago Mercury was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. Venus squares you from Libra, and the cost objects. Water opens the file, and the file has a price. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, is a stranger in Scorpio: neither strong nor weak. From Libra, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed fire keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Sun has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Sun in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury turned back three weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. Moon crosses your sign: nothing you hold is seen from a distance. Air starts and settles in the same breath. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. With Mercury in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Fixed water: what is kept and who keeps it merge. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Venus in Libra presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Earth moves first and pays first. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you and is weak in Aries: the grip tightens too soon. Moon in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.
